linapro-eval-360.name: 360 Performance Evaluation
linapro-eval-360.description: A plugin for management-level 360-degree performance evaluation. Built on the evaluation relationship (who evaluates whom) as its spine, it supports the project → questionnaire → evaluatee → relationship structure, role weights with pre-publish validation, full Excel import with a relationship editor, two-dimensional question visibility, one-click Lark push, and two HR-facing detail exports (by answer / by score).

relation.importHint: Click or drag an .xlsx file into this area to upload (columns: evaluatee name, evaluatee job title, evaluatee department, evaluator name, role; job title and department are optional). Employees are matched by name; rows whose name is shared by more than one active employee are rejected. Exported files can be imported again as-is.
relation.importDisabledHint: Published questionnaires cannot be fully imported; use add-relation below.
relation.empty: No evaluators yet. Click the button below to add one.
relation.gridHint: One evaluatee per row; fill evaluators in each role column, one "name employee-no" per line, multiple people on separate lines.

relation.batchGridHint: Each group has one evaluatee (name/job title/department on a single line; job title and department are optional); the right columns (evaluator name / role) align by line number, one evaluator per line. Click "Add" to append a group. Employees are matched by name; if any name is shared by more than one active employee or not found, nothing is submitted.

relation.batchEvaluatorIncomplete: Group {group} line {row}: evaluator name and role must both be filled

report.hint: Each button exports a single Excel of submitted answers only.
